        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Reveal first slide immediately
                if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            /* --- Intersection Observer: trigger .visible for animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel navigation with debounce --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 600) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index --- */
            goTo(index) {
                const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, this.slides.length - 1));
                if (clamped === this.currentIndex) return;
                this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* --- Progress bar --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dots --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.dots) return;
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Boot the presentation
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>

            /* UI accents */
            --accent-cyan:   #00d4ff;
            --accent-amber:  #f59e0b;
            --accent-rose:   #f43f5e;
            --accent-mint:   #34d399;

            /* Text */
            --text-primary:  #e2eaf6;
            --text-secondary:#8ba3c1;
            --text-muted:    #4a6280;
            --text-bright:   #ffffff;

            /* Borders */
            --border:        rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.12);
            --border-bright: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);

            /* Typography */
            --font-display:  'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-body:     'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono:     'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Type scale — all clamp() */
            --title-size:    clamp(1.6rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size:       clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size:       clamp(0.95rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size:     clamp(0.72rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            --small-size:    clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);
            --mono-size:     clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --dur-fast:      0.35s;
            --dur-normal:    0.6s;
            --dur-slow:      1s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0; padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT BASE CSS (from viewport-base.css)
           =========================================== */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE TYPOGRAPHY & GLOBAL ELEMENTS
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; }
        h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; }
        h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           Triggered via .visible class from IntersectionObserver
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.88);
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1), .reveal-scale:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2), .reveal-scale:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3), .reveal-scale:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5), .reveal-scale:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* ===========================================
           BACKGROUNDS — shared atmospheric layers
           =========================================== */
        .grid-bg::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .glow-bg::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08) 0%, transparent 45%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(224, 123, 74, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            width: 0%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--anthropic));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            z-index: 100;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px; height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADER COMPONENT
           Used across all content slides
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .slide-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            opacity: 0.7;
            padding-top: 0.3em;
            min-width: 2.5em;
        }

        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-top: 0.3em;
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.15;
            flex: 1;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           LAB COLOR CHIPS
           Consistent lab identification across slides
           =========================================== */
        .lab-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.35em;
            padding: 0.2em 0.6em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .lab-chip.openai   { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.18); color: var(--openai); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.35); }
        .lab-chip.google   { background: rgba(66,133,244,0.18); color: var(--google); border: 1px solid rgba(66,133,244,0.35); }
        .lab-chip.anthropic{ background: rgba(224,123,74,0.18); color: var(--anthropic); border: 1px solid rgba(224,123,74,0.35); }
        .lab-chip.muse     { background: rgba(192,132,252,0.18); color: var(--muse); border: 1px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.35); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-1 {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        #slide-1 .scan-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            animation: scanDown 4s ease-in-out infinite;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        @keyframes scanDown {
            0%   { top: 0%; opacity: 0; }
            10%  { opacity: 0.4; }
            90%  { opacity: 0.4; }
            100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0; }
        }

        #slide-1 .title-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        #slide-1 .eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        #slide-1 h1 {
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.1;
            max-width: 75%;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 2rem);
        }

        #slide-1 h1 em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        #slide-1 .subtitle {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: 60%;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);
        }

        #slide-1 .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        #slide-1 .meta-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        #slide-1 .meta-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        #slide-1 .meta-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        #slide-1 .accent-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--anthropic));
        }

        #slide-1 .corner-decor {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 4vh, 3rem);
            right: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — BENCHMARK LANDSCAPE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        #slide-2 {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .domain-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 580px);
        }

        .domain-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .domain-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); }

        .domain-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic::before  { background: var(--openai); }
        .domain-card.frontier::before { background: var(--muse); }
        .domain-card.safety::before   { background: var(--anthropic); }
        .domain-card.multimodal::before { background: var(--google); }

        .domain-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.1em;
        }

        .domain-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .domain-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .domain-benchmarks {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            margin-top: auto;
        }

        .domain-benchmarks li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 0.25em 0.5em;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            border-left: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic  .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.4); }
        .domain-card.frontier .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(192,132,252,0.4); }
        .domain-card.safety   .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(224,123,74,0.4); }
        .domain-card.multimodal .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(66,133,244,0.4); }

        .domain-leader {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            padding: 0.3em 0.5em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic  .domain-leader { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); color: var(--openai); }
        .domain-card.frontier .domain-leader { background: rgba(192,132,252,0.12); color: var(--muse); }
        .domain-card.safety   .domain-leader { background: rgba(224,123,74,0.12); color: var(--anthropic); }
        .domain-card.multimodal .domain-leader { background: rgba(66,133,244,0.12); color: var(--google); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — AGENTIC CODING LEADERS
           =========================================== */
        #slide-3 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .agentic-table-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .bench-row {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .bench-row.header-row {
            background: transparent;
            border-color: transparent;
            padding-bottom: 0.1em;
        }

        .bench-row.header-row span {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .bench-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .bench-entry {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.15em;
        }

        .bench-model {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .bench-score {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .bench-bar-wrap {
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }

        .bench-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.5s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .bench-bar { width: 0 !important; }

        .rank-1 .bench-bar { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .rank-2 .bench-bar { background: var(--accent-amber); opacity: 0.8; }
        .rank-3 .bench-bar { background: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.7; }

        .bench-entry.openai-color .bench-model { color: var(--openai); }
        .bench-entry.google-color .bench-model { color: var(--google); }
        .bench-entry.anthropic-color .bench-model { color: var(--anthropic); }
        .bench-entry.muse-color .bench-model { color: var(--muse); }
        .bench-entry.other-color .bench-model { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .legend-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 8px; height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — FRONTIER REASONING
           =========================================== */
        #slide-4 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .frontier-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
        }

        .frontier-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .frontier-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .hbar-group {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .hbar-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .hbar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 2fr) 3.5em;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }

        .hbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .hbar-track {
            height: 6px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.4s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .hbar-fill { width: 0 !important; }

        .hbar-score {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .saturation-callout {
            background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.4em;
        }

        .saturation-callout .callout-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-rose);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .saturation-callout .callout-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — MULTIMODAL / AUDIO & VISION
           =========================================== */
        #slide-5 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .multimodal-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
        }

        .mm-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Reveal first slide immediately
                if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            /* --- Intersection Observer: trigger .visible for animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel navigation with debounce --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 600) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index --- */
            goTo(index) {
                const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, this.slides.length - 1));
                if (clamped === this.currentIndex) return;
                this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* --- Progress bar --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dots --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.dots) return;
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Boot the presentation
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--anthropic));
        }

        #slide-1 .corner-decor {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 4vh, 3rem);
            right: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — BENCHMARK LANDSCAPE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        #slide-2 {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .domain-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 580px);
        }

        .domain-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .domain-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); }

        .domain-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic::before  { background: var(--openai); }
        .domain-card.frontier::before { background: var(--muse); }
        .domain-card.safety::before   { background: var(--anthropic); }
        .domain-card.multimodal::before { background: var(--google); }

        .domain-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.1em;
        }

        .domain-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .domain-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .domain-benchmarks {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            margin-top: auto;
        }

        .domain-benchmarks li {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 0.25em 0.5em;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            border-left: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic  .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.4); }
        .domain-card.frontier .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(192,132,252,0.4); }
        .domain-card.safety   .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(224,123,74,0.4); }
        .domain-card.multimodal .domain-benchmarks li { border-left-color: rgba(66,133,244,0.4); }

        .domain-leader {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            padding: 0.3em 0.5em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .domain-card.agentic  .domain-leader { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); color: var(--openai); }
        .domain-card.frontier .domain-leader { background: rgba(192,132,252,0.12); color: var(--muse); }
        .domain-card.safety   .domain-leader { background: rgba(224,123,74,0.12); color: var(--anthropic); }
        .domain-card.multimodal .domain-leader { background: rgba(66,133,244,0.12); color: var(--google); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — AGENTIC CODING LEADERS
           =========================================== */
        #slide-3 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .agentic-table-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .bench-row {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.8fr) repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .bench-row.header-row {
            background: transparent;
            border-color: transparent;
            padding-bottom: 0.1em;
        }

        .bench-row.header-row span {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .bench-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .bench-entry {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.15em;
        }

        .bench-model {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .bench-score {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .bench-bar-wrap {
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }

        .bench-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.5s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .bench-bar { width: 0 !important; }

        .rank-1 .bench-bar { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .rank-2 .bench-bar { background: var(--accent-amber); opacity: 0.8; }
        .rank-3 .bench-bar { background: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.7; }

        .bench-entry.openai-color .bench-model { color: var(--openai); }
        .bench-entry.google-color .bench-model { color: var(--google); }
        .bench-entry.anthropic-color .bench-model { color: var(--anthropic); }
        .bench-entry.muse-color .bench-model { color: var(--muse); }
        .bench-entry.other-color .bench-model { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .legend-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 8px; height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — FRONTIER REASONING
           =========================================== */
        #slide-4 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .frontier-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
        }

        .frontier-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .frontier-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .hbar-group {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .hbar-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .hbar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 2fr) 3.5em;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
        }

        .hbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .hbar-track {
            height: 6px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.4s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .hbar-fill { width: 0 !important; }

        .hbar-score {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .saturation-callout {
            background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.4em;
        }

        .saturation-callout .callout-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-rose);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .saturation-callout .callout-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — MULTIMODAL / AUDIO & VISION
           =========================================== */
        #slide-5 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .multimodal-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
        }

        .mm-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .mm-card-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .mm-card .hbar-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 2fr) 3.5em; }

        .mm-dominance-note {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.25);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .mm-dominance-note .big-stat {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--google);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .mm-dominance-note .stat-desc {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — SAFETY ALIGNMENT
           =========================================== */
        #slide-6 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .safety-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
        }

        .safety-panel {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .safety-panel-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .safety-panel-subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* MASK near-ceiling visual */
        .mask-gauge-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-around;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .gauge-row {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }

        .gauge-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: baseline;
        }

        .gauge-model {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .gauge-score {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .gauge-track {
            height: 10px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .gauge-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 5px;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.4s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .gauge-fill { width: 0 !important; }

        .ceiling-line {
            position: relative;
            height: 1px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            margin: 0.2em 0;
        }

        .ceiling-line::after {
            content: '100%';
            position: absolute;
            right: 0;
            top: -1.2em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* Fortress low scores panel */
        .fortress-panel { border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2); }

        .fortress-scores-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-around;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .fortress-entry {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .fortress-score-box {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-rose);
            min-width: 3.5em;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .fortress-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .fortress-bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: 6px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .fortress-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--accent-rose);
            opacity: 0.6;
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.4s;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .fortress-bar-fill { width: 0 !important; }

        .safety-insight {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — LAB COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE
           =========================================== */
        #slide-7 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .heatmap-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: min(72vh, 560px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .heatmap-header {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
            padding: 0 clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .hm-col-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0.3em 0.2em;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .hm-col-label.openai   { color: var(--openai);    background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12); }
        .hm-col-label.google   { color: var(--google);    background: rgba(66,133,244,0.12); }
        .hm-col-label.anthropic{ color: var(--anthropic); background: rgba(224,123,74,0.12); }
        .hm-col-label.muse     { color: var(--muse);      background: rgba(192,132,252,0.12); }

        .hm-rows {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.35rem);
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hm-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hm-bench-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 0 clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .hm-cell {
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem) clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.35rem);
            text-align: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .hm-cell.winner-openai   { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.25); color: var(--openai);    border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.5); }
        .hm-cell.winner-google   { background: rgba(66,133,244,0.25); color: var(--google);    border: 1px solid rgba(66,133,244,0.5); }
        .hm-cell.winner-anthropic{ background: rgba(224,123,74,0.25); color: var(--anthropic); border: 1px solid rgba(224,123,74,0.5); }
        .hm-cell.winner-muse     { background: rgba(192,132,252,0.25); color: var(--muse);     border: 1px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.5); }
        .hm-cell.no-win          { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px solid var(--border); }

        .hm-section-divider {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            margin: 0.1em 0;
        }

        .hm-section-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding: 0.1em clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }

        .muse-callout {
            background: rgba(192,132,252,0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(192,132,252,0.2);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .muse-callout strong { color: var(--muse); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8 — TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        #slide-8 { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .takeaways-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
            max-height: min(74vh, 560px);
        }

        .takeaway-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .takeaway-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 2px;
        }

        .takeaway-card.t-openai::after   { background: var(--openai); }
        .takeaway-card.t-google::after   { background: var(--google); }
        .takeaway-card.t-anthropic::after { background: var(--anthropic); }
        .takeaway-card.t-muse::after     { background: var(--muse); }
        .takeaway-card.t-key::after      { background: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .takeaway-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .takeaway-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .takeaway-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* Big-5 summary strip (last row) */
        .takeaway-card.full-width {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
        }

        .closing-strip {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.05), rgba(224,123,74,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.3rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .closing-text {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .closing-sub {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55%;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .closing-stat-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .closing-stat {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.1em;
        }

        .closing-stat-n {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .closing-stat-l {

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();

                // Reveal first slide immediately
                if (this.slides[0]) this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
            }

            /* --- Intersection Observer: trigger .visible for animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page up/down --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel navigation with debounce --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 600) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(this.currentIndex + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index --- */
            goTo(index) {
                const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, this.slides.length - 1));
                if (clamped === this.currentIndex) return;
                this.slides[clamped].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* --- Progress bar --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dots --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.dots) return;
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Boot the presentation
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
